_about: Prank gadgets. mode: projectile (flies straight-ish and hits the first thing), thrown (an arc that lands and splashes an area), place (put down at your feet, triggers when someone steps on it). Effects: soaked, slipped, blinded, embarrassed (seconds in 'effects'). onHit / onLand / onTrigger say what happens: effect, knock (push in m/s), signals (sent where it lands: type, range, color, chance). Friendly fire is always on. A new gadget is a new entry here: no code.

soaked.about: slips on the next sharp turn; a soaked coat wobbles

loadout._about: what a coat carries in the test build (the plan says 2 slots; 1, 2 and 3 pick, the mouse wheel cycles)

water_pistol.name: Water pistol
water_pistol.funny: Soak the guard, then watch him go over on the next corner.
water_pistol.useful: A soaked grown-up can't chase round corners; puddles slow everyone down.

slingshot.name: Slingshot
slingshot.funny: A full charge knocks the guard's hat over his eyes: three seconds of stumbling about.
slingshot.useful: Ping a tin from across the shop to send everyone the wrong way, or flip a light switch from afar.

banana_peel.name: Banana peel
banana_peel.funny: Whoever steps on it spins round and falls flat. Yes, your friends too.
banana_peel.useful: Drop one behind you in a chase.
